itemList.description: Subsurface Utility Engineerin (SUE) Survey : Conducting SUE survey in a corridor of 4-6 meter width to detect buried utilities like pipes, cables etc. in such corridor. Marking of the detected utilities on the map of corridor with information of locations and depths to the top of various utilities detected. Onsite detection to be conducted using minimum tools of Electronic Pipe Locatore (EPL) and Ground Penetrating Radar (GPR). GPR work to be conducted using 500MHz and 300MHz atenna for best possible resolution and penetration. the specifications are SUE survey should be in accordance with Code of Practice for Subsurface Utility Engineering Suiting indian Conditions - Guidelines & Specifications for Detection, Verification & Depiction of Existing Subsurface Utility Data

Seismic Refraction Survey/ MASW Survey : Conducting Seismic Refraction Survey or Multi Channel Analysis of Surface Waves (MASW) survey to determine stratigraphy along proposed rote i.e. soil, weathered rock, rock interfaces. Detection of faults, fractures, shear zones etc., in the investigatedarea. For Seismic Refraction Geophone spacing 5m and for MASW geophonr spacing of 2m is adequate. Test to be conducted using 24 channel signal enhancement type seismographSeismic Refraction 5m Geophone Spacing & for projects having a minimum length of 115 or MASW with 2m geophone spacing

Electrical Tomography: Conducting Electrical Tomography to determine shallow stratigarphy along the route, presence of voids, saturation zones, water table, and other geological features having contrast in resistivity with the surrounding soils. Electrode spacing 5 meters, minimum electrode spread of 60 electrodes.

Dewatering the sewage / storm water by using reqired HP submersible pump for the diversion of storm / sewage during the execution of work. Considering for 5 Pump. ((5pumps * 16hrs/day*30days) (40HP Pumps)

Excavation of Pits: Excavation of non-structural pits for pipe jacking/ramming purpose in soil inclusive of all shuttering, strutting and shoring and maintaining the shaft during construction operation and back filling the same after the completion of work.For Shafts up to 7.5m x 5m and up to a depth of 5m in all type of soil
For Shafts up to 7.5m x 5m and up to a depth of 5m in all type of soil mixed with soft rock

Installation of product pipe by Micro Tunneling method including concrete structural shaft of sheet piles/RCC retaining walls/well sinking/secant piling as par respective site requirements. (upto 100 meter of installation length and 5m depth) all inclusive as per IndSTT: 102-2018; Code of Practice for Micro Tunneling for slurry based microtunneling suitable for steel/RCC jacking pipes suiting indian condition.
